name: Dr. Craig Martell
biography: Dr. Craig Martell is the first-ever Chief Digital and AI Officer at the Department of Defense. Previously, he was the Head of Machine Learning at Lyft, the Head of Machine Intelligence at Dropbox, and led AI teams and initiatives at LinkedIn. He is also a tenured computer science professor in natural language processing at the Naval Postgraduate School.
